requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days.
The system shall anonymize student data in reports to protect identities.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years.
The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel under strict role-based access control.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall process attendance data in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide options to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
The system shall ensure data retention policies that align with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall offer a user interface that is optimized for low-power devices.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
